name: Nicolás Pascual de la Parte - § 49 - Am 85
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 49. Affirms that unanimity for decisions in the European Council, the Council and EU agencies, such as the European Defence Agency, remains vital to ensure Member States’ sovereignty over defence policy and respect for the neutrality of certain Member States;
